title: TaskPredictionOutput
description: Output schema for the 'Should I do this task now?' predictive productivity assessment

predictedScore.description: Calculated likelihood of successful focused completion (0-100)

confidence.description: Confidence tier based on historical session volume for this task type

riskLevel.description: Operational risk of failure, abandonment, or fatigue disruption

bestAlternativeWindow.description: Recommended time window to reschedule this task for optimal performance

reason.description: Explainable deterministic factors driving the calculated score

recommendation.description: Immediate actionable coaching advice for the user
